description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class that implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to enable logging with chaining capabilities, allowing log output to pass through multiple LogNode implementations. It includes methods for setting the next node in the chain and printing log messages with optional exception details.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's Log utility and implements the LogNode interface, enabling chained logging and forwarding of log messages.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list, used for chaining log outputs.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to receive log data after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message using Android's Log.println method, optionally appending the stack trace if a Throwable is provided. Forwards the log message to the next node if available.
